text: E-bike battery caught fire in an office on the 6th floor, 363 Sam Houston Pky, Houston.

out.briefing:
PRIMESIGHT | LITHIUM BATTERY / E-BIKE FIRE | FLOOR 6 | Northbelt, 363 Sam Houston Pky, Houston TX
ABOVE FIRE: ~159 people on floors 7-20. Fl 7 Safe Have Mental Health Solutions, possible vulnerable clients (from name only). Fl 9 salons, possible flammable products (from name only)
ON FLOOR: Ste 600 Unknown tenant, 605 Dream Counseling Center (possible vulnerable clients, from name only), 610 Tax Services Of Houston, 615 H5 Strategic Alliances, 640 Count It All Joy Tax Group, 660 Crystal CoWorks 4536 sqft (possible high occupancy, from name only)
WATER/WIND: 17 hydrants within 300 m, nearest ~137 m NE, 156 m NW. Wind from ENE 9 mph, gusts 23, smoke drifts WSW
INSIDE: 3D scan of this floor, 12 scan points. Exit signs seen from 10 of 12 scan points, pull stations from 5. Walk from scan start (not the entry): exit sign ~1 m, pull station within ~4 m, far end ~17 m
BUILDING: 20 stories, built 1981, steel frame, sprinklers yes, 7 passenger + 1 freight elevators
CREW NOTE: 2026-11-14 sprinkler pipe burst with water flowing on floor 6. Riser and shutoff locations not in data
ROOF: membrane, 4 AC units, 2 vents, 1 skylight, no solar
OPEN LOT for staging ~562 m SW and ~308 m E (aerial search, verify)
PROPERTY MGR: Realty.com 5559806802 (text asking them to meet crew is queued, not sent yet)
NOT KNOWN: stair locations, standpipe locations, sprinkler type, riser/shutoff, headcounts, any tenant battery storage
SCAN: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=Fv5Q2P8Kmsf

texts.text: Fire Dept: lithium e-bike battery fire in an office on floor 6, Northbelt, 363 Sam Houston Pky. Please meet the fire crew on arrival with keys and building info.

tenant_flags.why: (from name only) This looks like a coworking space. At 4,536 sq ft it is by far the largest tenant on the fire floor, and the number of people inside is unknown and may change through the day. Expect many occupants who don't know the building well, and plan a thorough primary search.
(from name only) A counseling practice on the fire floor may have clients in distress or with limited mobility who need help or calm guidance to get out.
(from name only) A mental health provider on the floor directly above the fire, where smoke is likely to reach first. Clients may need assistance. Suite number unknown.

tenant_flags.tenant: Floor 9 salons (Studio Nine Salon Suites, Front Cover Hair Studios, Upperhairchelon And Spa, SV Beauty And Spa, others)
tenant_flags.why: (from name only) A cluster of hair and beauty salons above the fire floor probably stores flammable aerosols, solvents, and oxidizers such as peroxide and acetone. Salon clients may also be in chairs or under treatment. Check this floor during vertical ventilation and the smoke search.

tenants: The Count It All Joy Tax Group

_facts.walk: walk from scan start: exit sign within ~4 m, far end ~17 m
